title: Ghul hai madine me bapa
body:
Ghul hai madine me bapa haaye haaye
Binte nabi ne ki qaza haaye haaye
Chain na bibi ko mila ek dam
Sehti rahi zulmo jafa haaye haaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Qabr me bechain hai roohe nabi
Ho gayi beti pa jafa haaye haaye
Haaye chali jald asaa tek kar
Pehlu pa wo sadma hua haaye haaye
